strings.choosereadme: Classic is a highly-customisable theme, based on Boost, with an alternative navigation layout. This theme is intended to be used directly, or as a parent theme when creating or updating custom themes to utilise Bootstrap 4.
strings.navbardarkdesc: Swaps text and background colours for the navbar at the top of the page between dark and light.
strings.preset_desc: Pick a preset to broadly change the look of the theme.
strings.presetfiles_desc: Preset files can be used to dramatically alter the appearance of a theme.
strings.privacy:metadata: The Classic theme does not store any personal data.
